name: ambika-crm
description: Ambika Group CRM (spec v1.4). Workspaces: packages/core (domain logic), web (Next.js static export), functions (Cloud Functions).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ag/core && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w @ag/functions
scripts.test:emulator: npx firebase-tools@15.34.1 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-ambika "npm run test -w @ag/emulator-tests"
